title: grammitis antipodalis
intro: Grammitis antipodalis, commonly known as New Zealand button fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis antipodalis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
